paite: Huan Tura kumpipa Hiram in Solomon kiang ah asikhate asawl hi; apa mun ah kumpipa in amah thau anilh uh chih lah ana zata ngal a. Hiram in David a-it gige him ahi.
heading: Tempul Lam Ding In Solomon Akisakhol / (2 Kro 2.1-18)
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon, for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the place of his father, and Hiram had always loved David.

paite: Solomon in mi sawl in Hiram kiang ah,
"Ka pa David in TOUPA'N akhepek nuai a akoih masiah akimvel a mun chih mual chih a kidounate ziak a TOUPA a Pathian min a dia inn alam theihlouhdan na thei hi.
english: “You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of Yahweh his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until Yahweh put his enemies under the soles of his feet.

paite: Tu in TOUPA ka Pathian in mun chih mual chih ah muanna ahon neisakta hi. Melma leh vangsiatna leng a-om kei hi.
english: But now Yahweh my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.

paite: Ngai dih, TOUPA'N ka pa David kiang ah, 'Na tapa na sik a na laltutphah ka luahsak ding in ka min a ding in inn ahon lam ding, chi a ana gensa bang in, TOUPA ka Pathian min a ding in inn lam ka tum hi.'
english: Behold, I intend to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, as Yahweh spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place shall build the house for my name.’

paite: Huaiziak in tu in Lebanon tang a sidar singte hon phuksak ding in thu pia inla, ka sikhate leng na sikhate lak ah ahong tel sam ding ua, na sikhate loh ahihleh na chih peuhmah ka hon pe ding. Zidon mite bang a sing phuksiam ka lak uah kuamah a-om kei uh, chih lah na thei ngal a," chi in agensak hi.
english: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say. For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Hiram in Solomon thu azak in akipak mahmah hi. "Hiai mi tampi tung a vaihawm dia tapa piltak David pepa TOUPA tuni in phat in om hen," achi hi.
english: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”

paite: Huchi in Hiram in Solomon kiang ah, "N'on thukhah ka na za hi. Sidar sing thu leh meilah sing thu na deih peuhmah ka hih ding.
english: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber.

paite: Ka sikhate'n Lebanon tang a pan tuipi pha in ahon lasuk ding ua, n'on mun sehsak a tuipi a tolh ding in ka gaklopsak ding hi. Huai ah ka phelsak dia, nang na na la ding hi. Nang leng ka inkote nek ding tum in ka deih na hon hihsak sam ding," chi in mi asawl hi.
english: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea. I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you specify to me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and you will receive them. You will accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.”

paite: Huchi in Hiram in sidar sing leh meilah sing Solomon deih teng apia hi.
english: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.

paite: Solomon in Hiram inkote nek ding in buh pota singnih leh sathau suk pota sawmnih apia hi. Hiai Solomon in kum teng a Hiram apiakdan ahi.
english: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat for food to his household, and twenty cors of pure oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.

paite: TOUPA'N achiam bangtak in Solomon pilna apia hi. Hiram leh Solomon kikal ah kilemna a-om a; anih un kilemna thukhun abawl uhi.
english: Yahweh gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.

paite: Kumpipa Solomon in Israel tengteng lak ah phutluih nasemmi abawl a; amau mi singthum ahi uh.
english: King Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.

paite: Lebanon ah kha khat a kikheng zel in singkhat asawl zel hi. Kha khat Lebanon ah a-om ua, kha nih amau inn ah. Phutluih nasem mite heutu Adoniram ahi.
english: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses: for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.

paite: Solomon in tangte ah thil pomi singsagih leh suangsekmi singgiat anei hi.
english: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains,

paite: Huaite sim louh in Solomon in anasep tung a heutu tuam, nasep vengmi sangthum-le-zathum anei lai hi.
english: besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work: three thousand three hundred who ruled over the people who labored in the work.

paite: Kumpipa thupiak in inn suangphum dia lep ding in suang lian pipi, suang mantam pipi leh suang seksa ahon pua uhi.
english: The king commanded, and they cut out large stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.

paite: Inn lam mite, Solomon mite leh Hiram mite leh Gebal mite'n suangte asek ua, huai inn lamna ding in sing leh suangte abawl uhi.
english: Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites cut them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.
